company: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE

revenue.source: FY2024/FY2025: LVMH FY2025 results release (lvmh.com): 84,683 and 80,807. FY2023 86,153: LVMH FY2023 release (from memory; not re-fetched, but consistent with stockanalysis implied ~86.1bn and -2% FY2024 change) - reviewer please verify.

operating_income.source: LVMH consolidated cash flow statement FY2025 financial documents (Dec 31 2025), 'Operating profit' (IFRS, after non-recurring items): 22,560 / 18,907 / 17,099. Note profit from recurring operations is higher: 22,802 / 19,571 / 17,755.

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com EPA:MC cash flow statement, Depreciation & Amortization FY2023/24/25 (data provider; scope vs LVMH's own D&A incl. right-of-use depreciation of 3,031/3,228/3,143 not verified).

capex.source: LVMH consolidated cash flow statement FY2025 financial documents: 'Operating investments' (7,478) / (5,531) / (4,567), shown positive.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 reported -5% / organic -1% with H2 organic +1% (LVMH FY2025 release), so FY2026 flat-to-slightly up in EUR (FX headwind); gradual recovery to mid-single-digit luxury growth, fading to 4% by FY2030.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 operating profit margin 17,099/80,807=21.2%, recurring margin 22.0%; FY2023 26.2%, FY2024 22.3%. Hold ~21.5% as modest recovery, below peak.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: French statutory corporate rate ~25.8%; LVMH effective rate historically mid-20s to ~27% (not verified in this session).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 operating investments 4,567/80,807=5.7%; FY2024 6.5%; FY2023 8.7%. Use 5.8% as normalised level.

wacc.source: Assumption: Rf ~3%, ERP ~5%, beta ~1.0 gives ~8% cost of equity; minimal net debt so WACC ~8%. Not computed from data provider inputs.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation ~2%, conservative for a luxury leader.

net_debt.source: LVMH FY2025 results release: net financial debt 6,857 at 31 Dec 2025 (excludes lease liabilities; LVMH definition nets cash, current available-for-sale financial assets and derivatives, so may differ slightly from strict gross debt - cash - ST investments).

diluted_shares.source: LVMH FY2025 consolidated financial statements, EPS note: shares for diluted EPS 497,976,118 (weighted average), expressed in millions.
